chunks: "A suitable match is one who is chaste and possesses financial means."

key_terms.اَلْكُفْؤُ: a suitable or compatible match in marriage
key_terms.عَفِيفًا: chaste; one who preserves moral purity

ai.seo_question: What makes a person a suitable match in marriage according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a criterion for compatibility in marriage. It identifies chastity and financial means as qualities that make a person a suitable match. The narration highlights moral integrity alongside material capacity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "A suitable match is one who is chaste and possesses financial means."
